- * input lets Gradle resolve those tasks first.

+ * refuses to read that list in a provider before those tasks run, but reads a task input only when
+ * the task runs. Wiring [mainManifest] as a task input instead makes Gradle run any
+ * manifest-generating tasks first, even though the main manifest is a static source file.
  */
